ui_guide_intro: A reference for comparing the buttons, sizes and colors already used in the product. Examples use the real component or the same classes as their source screen.
ui_guide_demo_note: Clicks are local demonstrations: they do not save, approve or delete data.
ui_guide_buttons_intro: The shared Button offers a primary style and a secondary option. Both are 40 px tall with 24 px horizontal padding; typography and corner radius depend on the screen.
ui_guide_primary_desc: Brand red (#CD2628). The base component defines neither corner radius nor a separate destructive variant.
ui_guide_secondary_desc: White in light mode, dark in dark mode. It has no built-in outline, so it can look like plain text on a white surface.
ui_guide_local_intro: These styles exist, but screens build them with local classes. They are not standardized options of a variant property yet.
ui_guide_outline_desc: Used for Copy in Facebook settings: border, rounded corners and 36 px height. It customizes the secondary button.
ui_guide_green_desc: Exists in post reviews. Uses green-600 and changes to green-700 on hover.
ui_guide_amber_desc: Exists for Request changes in post reviews. It is another local customization of the shared button.
ui_guide_destructive: Delete and cancel: current modal composition
ui_guide_destructive_desc: The decision modal uses the primary button for both confirmation and cancellation. Delete receives the same styling as other actions; the component has no danger variant. Both clicks here are simulations only.
ui_guide_sizes_intro: Samples found in the code, with their current proportions. This variety comes from per-screen overrides; Button has no central size scale.
ui_guide_size_profiles: Profiles: 12 px text, border and 4 px radius.
ui_guide_size_facebook: Facebook: 14 px text, border and 8 px radius.
ui_guide_size_default: Original Button height. Font size inherited from context.
ui_guide_size_login: Login: taller button with 10 px radius.
ui_guide_states_intro: Real states of the shared component. Use Tab to observe focus and hover over the examples to compare visual feedback.
ui_guide_disabled_desc: Uses native disabled, reduced opacity and blocked pointer events.
ui_guide_loading_desc: White spinner, hidden text and reduced opacity. Loading alone does not set disabled or aria-busy yet.
ui_guide_secondary_loading_desc: The same white spinner can disappear against the light background. This is an existing inconsistency to fix in the base component.
ui_guide_colors_intro: The colors below come from shared theme variables. Approval green and review amber are still applied locally to buttons.
ui_guide_typography_desc: The main layout uses Plus Jakarta Sans. These text samples help compare sizes found in the frontend; they do not form a mandatory scale for all components yet.
ui_guide_decisions_intro: Topics for the next UX/UI review. The proposals below have not been applied to product components.
ui_guide_gap_variants: No centralized variants for outlined, subtle, success or destructive actions.
ui_guide_gap_sizes: Height, typography, padding and corners are adjusted per screen. Primary and cancel actions sometimes have the same emphasis.
ui_guide_gap_loading: Loading needs contrast in both themes, an accessible name and consistent keyboard blocking.
ui_guide_gap_focus: Global CSS removes the default outline. Keyboard focus is not standardized in the base button yet.
ui_guide_propose_variants: Define roles first: primary, outlined secondary, subtle and destructive. Use green approval only where meaningful.
ui_guide_propose_sizes: Consider a short scale: small 32 px, default 40 px and large 48 px, with justified exceptions.
ui_guide_propose_semantics: Use text and context to distinguish Save from Delete. Color alone does not convey the action’s intent.
ui_guide_propose_rollout: Approve the standard in this catalog and migrate one screen at a time while preserving existing behavior.

fb_guide_prerequisite: Before starting: save the app credentials and connect the Page in Integrations through Facebook Login. Then choose how to authorize its automations.
fb_guide_method: How would you like to authorize?
fb_guide_login_authorize: Register the OAuth redirect URL shown in this tab in Meta. Select the Page in MultiPost, click Authorize Page and complete login. The token is obtained automatically.
fb_guide_system_token: Assign the app and Page to the system user. Generate a token for the same App ID registered in MultiPost Facebook and save it in the System user tab. Return to Facebook, select the Page and click Use system user.
fb_guide_shared_webhook: For either method, configure the webhook once in Messenger. It is shared by the app’s Pages; changing the callback affects all of them.
fb_guide_activate: After saving the webhook in Meta, return to Facebook and use Check and activate reception for the selected Page. When ready, create your automation.
fb_auto_meta_path_help: Where can I find this option?
meta_system_prerequisite: The token does not connect Pages automatically. Assign assets to the user and apply authorization to the desired Page.
meta_threads_automation_limit: This configuration connects the Threads account; it does not enable comment automations.
meta_credentials_test_ok: Credentials valid. Authorization and reception are checked on the Page below.
meta_diagnostic_revocation: Token revocation or permission changes can interrupt access, even without a scheduled expiration.
meta_diagnostic_no_comments: No received comment is recorded for this Page.
meta_diagnostic_source_notice: Recorded when the system user was applied. This token is different from the Page token.
meta_diagnostic_assets_notice: Assets returned by the last validation. Finding them does not connect them or enable automations in MultiPost.
meta_diagnostic_app_missing: No credentials saved in this section
meta_diagnostic_app_not_validated: Saved credentials do not confirm account connectivity or permissions.
messenger_trigger_hint: Responds to keywords received by the Page. Story replies may also arrive as ordinary messages.
messenger_keyword_hint: Add at least one keyword. Matching is case-insensitive.
messenger_priority_hint: From 1 to 1000: the lowest number wins. If multiple automations match, only the highest-priority one is chosen, even if a condition stops its reply.
messenger_app_subscription_help: In the credentials Messenger tab, open help and subscribe to messages in the Meta webhook. Then check the connection again.
messenger_receiving_help: Authorize this Page and enable message receiving to use this trigger.
messenger_activation_failed: Receiving could not be confirmed. Check the setup and try again.
messenger_run_skipped: This automation did not send a reply: another rule had priority or a Page configuration conflict was found.
messenger_run_condition: This automation won priority, but a condition ended its path before replying. No other rule took over the message.
shared_error_messenger_keywords_required: Add at least one Messenger keyword.
shared_error_invalid_priority: Priority must be an integer from 1 to 1000.
shared_error_messenger_rule_conflict: An active automation already uses this rule on the Page. Edit it or choose different keywords.
shared_error_messenger_priority_conflict: This priority is already in use on the Page. Choose another number before activating.
shared_error_messenger_page_in_use: This Page already receives messages through another connection. Review the owning connection before activating.
shared_error_messenger_app_subscription_: Subscribe to messages in the Meta app Messenger webhook settings.
shared_error_messenger_page_subscription: Enable Messenger receiving for this Page before activating the automation.
shared_error_messenger_public_reply_unsu: Messenger messages do not support public replies. Remove that block.
shared_error_messenger_facebook_only: The Messenger trigger requires exactly one Facebook Page.
shared_error_messenger_post_target_unsup: Messenger messages are selected by keywords, without post targeting.
messenger_page_hint: Select the Page that will reply to messages.
shared_error_messenger_delay_too_long: For Messenger, total delay must be less than 24 hours. Sending requires the window to still be open.
shared_error_subscription_update_busy: This Page subscription is being updated. Wait and check the connection again.
fb_post_lookup_title: Dark Post or post by ID
fb_post_help_title: Where can I find the ID?
fb_post_lookup_help: In Ads Manager, open the ad preview and its post with comments. Copy the post ID or permanent link. Use the post ID, not the ad or campaign ID.
fb_post_lookup_formats: Accepts numeric IDs, full ID (Page_Post), and /posts/ID, permalink.php or /reel/ID links. For videos, Meta must confirm the related Page post. Short links (share), pfbid and ad IDs are not accepted.
fb_post_lookup_hint: Combine gallery posts and Dark Posts in the same selection. Use an ID or link to add a post that is missing from the list.
fb_post_error_reference: We could not recognize this format. Use the post ID or a permanent link with a numeric ID.
fb_post_error_owner: We could not confirm that this post belongs to the selected Page. Check the ID and Page.
fb_post_error_access: Meta denied access. Check the Page authorization in Credentials and try again.
fb_post_error_unavailable: We could not retrieve this post. Check the ID, Page access and whether the format is supported.
fb_post_error_retry: The lookup did not complete. Wait a moment and try again.
shared_posts_limit: You can select up to 100 posts. Remove one to add another.
fb_post_error_rate: Too many lookups in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

media_settings_section_description: Click a media item to set its alt text, or its thumbnail if it is a video.
media_settings_section_tooltip: Thumbnails apply to videos in the main post and are sent to every channel that supports them. YouTube may ignore them on videos it treats as Shorts (vertical, up to 3 minutes) without failing the publish, and requires a phone-verified channel for custom thumbnails. If YouTube rejects the thumbnail the video is still published, and Robô MultiPost cannot check eligibility in advance.
youtube_thumbnail_overrides_media: This post has a YouTube-specific thumbnail, which overrides the thumbnail set in the media settings.
